title: Updating an Original Register
statement: For any natural number $R$, register assignment $\rho:\{0,\ldots,R-1\}\to\mathbb N$, natural numbers $p,oc,tm,v$, and register $r$, updating register $r$ to $v$ in the extended assignment $(\rho,p,oc,tm)$ gives the extended assignment formed by first updating $r$ to $v$ in $\rho$ and leaving the three auxiliary coordinates unchanged.
